section.p: When the loop finishes, the SDK triggers and reports the playback state as .

note.p: For on-demand playback, the SDK triggers when a playback iteration completes. If more repeats remain, it reports (5) and continues playback. After the final iteration, it reports (6).
If you do not call this method or set loopCount to 0, the media resource plays once and reports (6) when playback completes. Each iteration reports only one completion state.

section.title: On-demand playback scenarios
section.p: Only playback-completion and stop states are listed. Intermediate states such as opening and playing are omitted.

plentry.pd:
The number of times the audio effect loops:
≥0: Number of times for playing. For example, setting it to 0 means no loop playback, playing only once; setting it to 1 means loop playback once, playing a total of twice.
-1: Play the audio file in an infinite loop.

The number of repeats after the initial playback:
≥ 0: The repeat count. The total number of playbacks is loopCount + 1. For example, 0 plays once without repeating; 1 repeats once, for two playbacks in total.
-1: Repeat the media resource indefinitely. Each playback iteration reports (5) when it completes.

section.p: When the method call succeeds, there is no return value; when fails, the exception is thrown. You need to catch the exception and handle it accordingly. See for details and resolution suggestions.
